trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the platinum trophy by completing all 54 other single-player trophies. This is the game's highest achievement, unlocking after you finish everything else.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing early in Chapter 1. This is one of the first main story missions you'll encounter.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. This progresses the narrative to Chapter 2 and unlocks new areas and missions.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. This chapter introduces new characters and locations in Vice City's underworld.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. This chapter expands the game world and introduces major heist opportunities.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. This is the final chapter before the endgame content unlocks.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the main story. This triggers the endgame and unlocks the 100% completion checklist in free-roam.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run (Check on Jason). This is an early story mission after Chapter 2 begins.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the major Chapter 3 heist mission The Cartel Heist. This is one of the game's largest set-piece missions.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. This mission focuses on family dynamics and personal relationships.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. This mission involves media and celebrity culture in Vice City.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 airport mission VCIA Takedown. This involves taking down an operation at the airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. This is a major operation mission in the story's later stages.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion of the game. This requires earning all other trophies and completing all content, including activities, collectibles, and challenges.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts throughout the game world. Stunts are aerial and vehicle tricks performed while moving, often near stunt jumps.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types available in the game at least once. Activities include racing, flying, shooting, and more.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This requires mastering all shooting range drill types and achieving the highest rank in each.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations throughout Leonida. Each location has a drone race course to complete.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races anywhere in the game. Races can be story missions, side activities, or free-roam races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. This is a side activity involving fishing competitions with the character Cal.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game available in the game. GTA 6 features classic arcade games you can play at arcades found around the city.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for the character Andy. This is a character-specific mission strand in the game's story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for the character Kenton. This is a character-specific mission strand reflecting story choices.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for the character Billy. This concludes his mission strand in the game's narrative.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. These are optional character-driven missions that expand the game's world and lore.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for the character Randy. This is a character-specific mission strand in the game's story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for the character Tyrone. This concludes his mission strand in the game's narrative.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. There are 10 locations with multiple meditation sessions. Note: The first meditation spot at Jason's house is only available during Chapter 1 and is potentially missable. Complete it before progressing past Chapter 1 to avoid risking this trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for the character Bret. This is a hunting side activity featuring unique animal targets across Leonida.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. GTA 6 features collectible card games that you can find and play throughout the world, with various card sets to collect.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. The WAiNK is a social feature or device that you can interact with at various locations throughout the game world.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges throughout the game. Challenges are various tasks and objectives scattered across the game world, ranging from stunt challenges to skill tests.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while accompanied by your partner. This requires evading the police with another character in your vehicle or vicinity.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. This requires coordinated shop robberies while maintaining a high wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles throughout the game world. Vehicles include cars, motorcycles, boats, aircraft, and other modes of transportation found across Leonida.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is a targeting system that slows time and helps you acquire targets quickly.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This involves leaving VCIA (Vice City International Airport) in an unexpected way, such as stealing a plane or vehicle.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos (tanks). This involves encountering or using Rhino tanks, the heavy military vehicles found in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This stealth-based robbery requires avoiding security systems, cameras, and guards.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. This involves planning and executing bank robberies, then escaping with the loot while evading police.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks can be found roaming the game world and contain valuable loot.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The game world is divided into distinct areas, and discovering each one contributes to this trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in the game. Each gang controls different illegal operations throughout Leonida.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a relaxed, story-adjacent activity at the Ocean Beach strip in Vice City.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Find a vehicle showroom and crash through the display windows to steal a high-end vehicle.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. Bowling is a leisure activity available at specific alleys in the game world.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Call your partner to join you before working out at a fitness club so both characters gain Strength simultaneously.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices that affect your Criminal Profile throughout the game (turn on Criminal Profile UI notifications in Settings to track it). Your choices have consequences that are tracked.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. This trophy relates to activities where you need to retry after an initial failure.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This relates to UFO or paranormal Easter egg events hidden in Leonida that can be encountered during normal gameplay.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. This involves using melee weapons while driving a vehicle to knock down targets.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. This is a financial crime activity involving washing money through legitimate channels.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops across the game. Make purchases at various shops and businesses throughout Leonida.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties available in the game. Garages are properties you can purchase to store vehicles and establish safehouses.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app is a in-game service for vehicle registration and management.
